capabilities: Route notes to folders using ordered rules with tag, property, filename, date, and link triggers
Build destination paths dynamically from {{tag.}} and {{property.}} placeholders
Preview planned moves before executing single-note or bulk moves
Undo past moves through recorded move history
Automatically move notes on save or on a periodic schedule, with attachment co-move support
extras: Automation triggers (on-edit and periodic) are off by default and must be enabled in settings. Works on desktop and mobile and requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. Settings can be exported and imported as JSON to transfer configurations between vaults.
problem: Notes pile up in an inbox and manually dragging each one to the right folder is tedious and easy to skip.
summary: Rule-based note mover that routes notes into folders based on tags, frontmatter properties, filenames, dates, links, and other metadata.
